security_audit.summary: The skill contains five documented npx commands for updating, scaffolding, linting, and validating HyperFrames projects. These commands are legitimate workflow actions but require user approval because they execute external package tooling. The remaining static alerts are Markdown or fixed relative-reference false positives, and no prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: External npx commands are required by the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Explain the expected package, working directory, and file effects before each command, and request approval before execution.
Document that referenced paths are fixed sibling skill resources and validate resolved paths remain inside the installed skill bundle.

content.value_statement: Complex video projects need a consistent process for planning, design, assembly, and review. This skill guides HyperFrames composition work through structured stages and final validation.
actual_capabilities: Routes fresh work through the HyperFrames workflow before custom composition work begins.
Creates or edits multi-scene compositions, brand reels, montages, loops, title cards, and footage remixes.
Builds plans with viewer arc, structure, rhythm, scene treatment, and duration guidance.
Applies storyboard, design, media, animation, and production references when their conditions match.
Runs HyperFrames lint and check commands during the documented validation stages.
Requires final preview approval before rendering a requested video.
limitations: It depends on the HyperFrames ecosystem and its referenced skills being installed.
It does not render a video until the user approves the final Studio preview.
External media providers may require sign-in, billing, or an available offline alternative.
It does not replace specialized workflows for short motion-first units.

use_cases.title: Build a brand reel
use_cases.description: Plan and assemble a multi-scene brand video with a defined visual identity and final approval gate.

use_cases.title: Revise a client composition
use_cases.description: Apply a specific edit while preserving project decisions and rerunning the affected checks.

use_cases.title: Create a guided montage
use_cases.description: Co-create a footage montage with story treatment, media handling, and storyboard checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Start a simple title card
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom HyperFrames title card for a 10-second product announcement. Use a clear visual hierarchy and ask for final approval before rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a brand reel
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a 45-second brand reel with four scenes. Define the viewer arc, rhythm, scene purpose, and visual treatment before building.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an existing composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the existing HyperFrames composition by replacing the opening headline. Preserve all other project decisions and run the affected checks.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a companion-flow video
prompt_templates.prompt: Use companion flow to co-create a 60-second customer story. Propose a complete treatment, identify optional media needs, and record accepted choices in the brief.

output_examples.input: Create a 30-second product montage for a mobile app.
output: A scene plan with a viewer arc and timing guidance.
A composition build with approved media and motion treatment.
A final preview request after validation completes.

output_examples.input: Change the final scene in an existing brand reel.
output: The requested scene revision while preserving recorded decisions.
A report of the checks rerun after the change.
A request for approval before rendering.

best_practices: Provide the target duration, audience, message, and available assets before planning.
Review the storyboard when scene order or visual direction needs feedback.
Approve the final preview only after checking the reported validation results.
anti_patterns: Do not use this workflow for a short motion-first unit when motion-graphics is the better route.
Do not add scenes, audio, or captions that the user did not request or approve.
Do not render before the final Studio preview receives approval.

faq.question: What projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports custom HyperFrames compositions, including multi-scene videos, brand reels, montages, loops, title cards, and footage remixes.

faq.question: When should I use a different workflow?
faq.answer: Use motion-graphics for a short unnarrated motion-first unit. Route fresh creation through HyperFrames first.

faq.question: Does it support existing projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It can apply a specific edit or resume from a brief, storyboard, or HyperFrames project state.

faq.question: Does it require a storyboard?
faq.answer: A storyboard is used when the brief sets storyboard to yes. Otherwise the workflow can continue without opening a board.

faq.question: Can it use external media providers?
faq.answer: Yes, when the media workflow supports the need. Authenticated providers may require sign-in, billing, or an offline alternative.

faq.question: When does rendering happen?
faq.answer: Rendering happens only after validation passes and the user approves the final Studio preview.
